subject: [RFC PATCH 1/5] mm: let folio_mkclean() report which pages had dirty PTEs

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged a mistake in the patch and promised to fix it by restructuring the code in v2.

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the folio_mkclean() function to report which pages had dirty PTEs by introducing a new function, folio_mkclean_dirtymap(). The latter takes a bitmap and sets a bit for every page of the folio whose entry was dirty. The original folio_mkclean() function is now a wrapper that passes no bitmap, preserving its existing behavior. This change allows downstream code to track which parts of a large folio were written through a mapping, rather than assuming the whole folio changed.
